qualification.details: Qualification: Degree in Mechanical or Electrical or Marine or Instrumentation or Refrigeration Engineering from a recognized University or Institution; Officers under the Central or State Governments or Union Territories or Universities or Recognized Research Institutions or Semi-Government or Autonomous or Statutory Organization holding analogous posts on regular basis, or with 5 years' regular service in posts in Pay Band Rs.15600-39100 + Grade Pay Rs. 6600 or equivalent Experience: 8 years experience of erection and maintenance or repairs of plant and machinery in a manufacturing unit as also any kind of fresh installation/modernization of dairy plant, out of which at least 5 years should be in a Dairy Plant Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications) | Other conditions: | Applicants must be officers who could be spared in the event of their selection

how_to_apply: Fill in the application in the enclosed proforma (Annexure: Proforma/Bio-Data).
Get the Employer's Endorsement on the proforma signed with office seal.
Enclose up to date CR dossier, vigilance clearance, integrity certificate and statement of major/minor penalties imposed during the last eight years.
Send the application to the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi within 60 days from the date of issue of the Memorandum.
Make sure it reaches by 16 January 2027.
important_instructions: Applications received without CR dossiers or after the due date may not be considered Officers who volunteer for this post will not be allowed to withdraw their name later on Experience qualification is relaxable at the discretion of UPSC for SC/ST candidates Consultation with the UPSC is necessary on each occasion

content_sections.heading: DAHD Notification PDF 2027
content_sections.text: Advt No. M-03013/65/2026-Admin- 4 (E43391) gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DAHD notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Degree in Mechanical or Electrical or Marine or Instrumentation or Refrigeration Engineering from a recognized University or Institution; Officers under the Central or State Governments or Union Territories or Universities or Recognized Research Institutions or Semi-Government or Autonomous or Statutory Organization holding analogous posts on regular basis, or with 5 years' regular service in posts in Pay Band Rs.15600-39100 + Grade Pay Rs. 6600 or equivalent Experience: 8 years experience of erection and maintenance or repairs of plant and machinery in a manufacturing unit as also any kind of fresh installation/modernization of dairy plant, out of which at least 5 years should be in a Dairy Plant Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications) Other conditions: Applicants must be officers who could be spared in the event of their selection

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for DAHD Recruitment 2027
content_sections.text: Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion (for deputation) Deputationists are not eligible for appointment by promotion

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Period of deputation (including short term contract), with any preceding ex-cadre deputation, shall ordinarily not exceed 4 years Probation of one year for direct recruits

content_sections.heading: How Will DAHD Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Composite Method (Deputation/Short-Term Contract plus Promotion) Direct Recruitment

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in the enclosed proforma with Employer's Endorsement Up to date CR dossier Vigilance clearance Integrity certificate Statement of major/minor penalties imposed during the last eight years

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DAHD Recruitment 2027 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the enclosed proforma (Annexure: Proforma/Bio-Data). Get the Employer's Endorsement on the proforma signed with office seal. Enclose up to date CR dossier, vigilance clearance, integrity certificate and statement of major/minor penalties imposed during the last eight years. Send the application to the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi within 60 days from the date of issue of the Memorandum. Make sure it reaches by 16 January 2027.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications received without CR dossiers or after the due date may not be considered Officers who volunteer for this post will not be allowed to withdraw their name later on Experience qualification is relaxable at the discretion of UPSC for SC/ST candidates Consultation with the UPSC is necessary on each occasion

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DAHD Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DAHD Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Senior Dairy Engineer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DAHD Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure - Proforma/Bio-Data enclosed with the Office Memorandum (page 4; Hindi version page 11)) and send it to Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi-110001, by post, to reach by 16 January 2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay Level-12 of the Pay Matrix, Rs. 78800-209200 (pre-revised PB-3 Rs.15,600-39,100 + Grade Pay Rs.7,600).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree in Mechanical or Electrical or Marine or Instrumentation or Refrigeration Engineering from a recognized University or Institution, plus 8 years experience of erection and maintenance or repairs of plant and machinery in a manufacturing unit as also any kind of fresh installation/modernization of dairy plant, at least 5 years in a Dairy Plant; deputationists must also hold analogous posts or have 5 years' regular service in PB Rs.15600-39100 + Grade Pay Rs. 6600 or equivalent.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants must be officers who could be spared in the event of their selection.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion (for deputation). Deputationists are not eligible for appointment by promotion.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Composite Method (Deputation/Short-Term Contract plus Promotion). Direct Recruitment.

faq.answer: Period of deputation (including short term contract), with any preceding ex-cadre deputation, shall ordinarily not exceed 4 years. Probation of one year for direct recruits.
